title: Error orchestration insights and trace-enrichment pipeline
creator: Aditi Sharma
description: Create an integrated failure taxonomy and visualization set that surfaces root causes across the inference stack (client HTTP/gRPC codes, network timeouts, overload, kernel/model runtime errors, and model output errors). Instrument trace hooks and enrich logs/metrics so dashboards can correlate traces, request attributes (model variant, seq_len, routing policy), and error signals for fast TTR.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical failure taxonomy defined and stored in Confluence with mapping to HTTP/gRPC codes, runtime error classes, and overload signatures
Instrumented trace hook (server-side) that injects failure_reason tag for sampled traces and emits span-level error metadata
Log/metric pipeline rule that normalizes error_reason field across services and writes to observability index (kibana/datadog)
Grafana dashboard with panels: error-rate by failure_reason, latency P50/P95/P99 per failure_reason, model-error vs infra-error split, overload heatmap, and top contributing routes
Drilldown links from dashboard to traces (Jaeger/Tempo) and related GitHub PR/incident runbook
Automated alert thresholds for sudden increases in 'overload' or 'model-runtime-error' with runbook link
tasks: Draft taxonomy and mapping (backend, serving runtime, API layers)
Add trace hook to inference gateway to attach request metadata and initial failure_reason if observed
Update collector pipeline (fluentd/tempo) to carry normalized error_reason and model_variant tags
Build Grafana panels + templating variables (env, model, region)
Create Datadog monitors for error spikes and latency regressions
Run internal dogfood for 2 weeks, collect feedback, iterate
comments: 2025-02-16 - Aditi: Initial taxonomy draft posted to Confluence. Asked infra to capture kernel-runtime error codes (OOM, CUDA kernel failures) as separate classes.
2025-02-20 - Luca: Implemented first-pass trace hook in edge gateway - attaches request_id, model_variant, seq_len, route_policy. Sampling at 1% to start.
2025-02-24 - Megha R. (PM): Please make model-error category distinguish between deterministic rejection (bad prompt) vs runtime failure. Suggests adding 'model_output_validation' metric.

2025-02-27 - Eng lead: Tradeoff reviewed - increasing trace sampling to 5% for error paths only (based on logs) to reduce noise. Decision: keep uniform 1% for healthy paths, conditional sampling +100% on any 5xx at gateway.
2025-03-01 - Observability: Added normalization rules in fluentd pipeline. We map HTTP 502/503 to 'upstream-unavailable', gRPC CANCELLED to 'client-cancel', and kernel OOM to 'kernel-oom'.
next_steps: Finish Grafana panels and share for PM/design review (by 2025-03-05)
Ramp conditional trace sampling for error paths and re-run dogfood tests (by 2025-03-10)
Bake alert threshold proposal into runbook and run two incident drills (by 2025-03-12)
